H-M_power.label: EXPLORATORY, POST HOC; design recommendation, not a result
H-M_power.method: per curve: model true means = grand + shrink * (observed model mean - grand) with shrink = sqrt(max(0, 1 - 1/F_obs)) (moment shrinkage; 'observed' scenario: shrink = 1; 'null': shrink = 0); each model's observed 64 rows are rescaled to the true model mean and resampled with replacement n times; parametric F(7, 8n-8) p-values; Holm over the 12 curves; counted: ic significant on >= 6 of 12

log_variance_share_p1.note: T = F * T0 exactly; var(logT)=var(logF)+var(logT0)+2cov; F is the crater (automorphism) factor with transport in numerator and denominator, T0 the control ratio

S.note: row bootstrap over the pooled Tcr pairs ignoring vertex clustering; 1000 replicates for the quantile CIs

canon.note: row bootstrap over the pooled Tcr pairs ignoring vertex clustering; 1000 replicates for the quantile CIs

breakeven.definition: p* = (C(rho-neg,N_v) - C(rho-cubic,Tcr_v)) / M_v. (a) C = charged ops_gae only (uncharged work unpriced); (b) C with every uncharged op priced at 1 GAE; (c) the plan's T_v(p)=1 with the same p on uncharged counters and point maps: finite only if M_v + unc(cubic) - unc(neg) > 0

cochran_Q_price1.0.note: SE from the per-vertex percentile CI width / (2*1.96): approximate

assumptions: solve cost = c * sqrt(r) GAE with c = measured vertex-averaged mean S of rho-cubic on the Tcr rows; the ~371-op additive part is taken to scale with sqrt(r) like the rest
transport = 2 * depth Velu point maps (G and Q), each priced at p GAE, p in {0.1, 1}, independent of bit size (an l = 2 Velu map is a fixed number of field operations, like a group operation)
depth scenarios: measured vertex-weighted mean depth; 6 (the measured maximum, held fixed); 6 * bits / 26 (depth growing linearly with the bit size)
not modelled: finding the path to the crater, existence of a j = 0 volcano of that depth at that size, cofactors, the order-6 class machinery at that size

mechanism.interpretation: legendre_symbols_uncharged (constant within a model) counts the Legendre symbols evaluated while sampling the 64-point prime-abscissa factor base on that model (docs/ecbench/README.md: Legendre symbols and square roots of point sampling); sqrt_solves is 64 everywhere. It is a measure of how many candidate abscissas were needed to find 64 points, not of relation yield.

yield_mechanism.H_definition: H = 2 k0 + 4 C(k0, 2) + 2 npair: distinct elements +-P_i (P_i in <G>), +-P_i +- P_j (both in <G>, or [r]P_i = +-[r]P_j) that lie in <G>, i.e. relation sources with at most two factor-base columns
yield_mechanism.factor_base_rule: the 64 smallest abscissae x = 1, 2, ... on the curve, both signs (src/cryptanalysis/ic_boundary.rs prime_factor_base); 'prime-abscissa' means prime field, not prime x
